'''Mesem''' (Mesẽ) is a [[Papuan languages|Papuan language]] spoken in [[Morobe Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]].

== Names ==
The alternate names for Mesem are Mese, Momalili, and Momolili.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Glottolog 5.1 - Mese |url=https://glottolog.org/resource/languoid/id/mese1244 |access-date=2025-02-12 |website=glottolog.org}}</ref>
